mostWorthwhile.text: Concentrating drifting rocky pebbles at a pressure maximum was most worthwhile: it showed how gathering solids can bypass the limits of simple sticking.

leastWorthwhile.text: The icy-swarm collapse was the least distinctive passage because it repeated the established rocky sequence.

surprise.text: Gas drag can cause pebbles to drift and help concentrate them, rather than merely slowing them down.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt entirely purposeless, although the icy route combined pebbles directly with the pressure maximum while its result also invoked gas drag; that shortcut was less explicit than the rocky route.

continue.text: Yes. I would be interested to see how these rocky and icy bodies evolve, particularly what happens to their water, after the useful explanation of how they form.
